questions.question: In-toto attestation framework nima?
questions.explanation: Supply chain bo'ylab "chain of custody" ni kriptografik tasdiqlash — har qadamda (commit, build runner, test) metadata yozib imzolanadi.

questions.question: Rekor transparency log nima?
questions.explanation: Supply chain metadata va Cosign imzolarini yozadigan public, append-only, buzilishni ko'rsatuvchi Merkle tree ledger.

questions.question: Fulcio CA nima?
questions.explanation: Sigstore boshqaradigan bepul public CA: OIDC identity'ga bog'langan qisqa muddatli (~10 daqiqa) X.509 sertifikatlar beradi.

questions.question: Vault'da Shamir's Secret Sharing nima?
questions.explanation: Unseal (root) kalitini N ta ulushga bo'lib, kamida M tasi (masalan 5 dan 3) bilan tiklash — Vault'ni unseal qilish uchun bitta odam yetarli emas.

questions.question: Vault auto-unseal nima?
questions.explanation: Vault'ni cloud KMS (AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS) yoki HSM bilan qo'lda kalit kiritmasdan avtomatik unseal qilish (recovery key'lar baribir kerak).

questions.question: Kubernetes KMS v2 provider nima?
questions.explanation: etcd'dagi Secret'larni DEK cache'lash bilan envelope encryption orqali shifrlaydigan yuqori unumdor at-rest shifrlash API'si (1.29+ da GA).

questions.question: IAM session policy (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: AssumeRole paytida uzatilib, o'sha sessiya uchun role ruxsatlarini qo'shimcha cheklaydigan policy — masalan bitta job'ga faqat bitta bucket.

questions.question: Cloud IAM'da confused deputy muammosi nima?
questions.explanation: Huquqi yo'q tomon huquqli servisni o'zi uchun harakat qilishga majburlashi (masalan uchinchi tomon SaaS orqali boshqa mijoz akkauntiga kirish). Trust policy'da sts:ExternalId, servislar uchun aws:SourceArn/aws:SourceA...

questions.question: Certificate Transparency (CT) nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha chiqarilgan TLS sertifikatlarini yozadigan public append-only log'lar — CA'lar yashirincha soxta sertifikat chiqara olmaydi; o'z domeningizni CT monitoring bilan kuzating.

questions.question: OCSP stapling nima?
questions.explanation: Web server CA'dan sertifikat revocation holatini muntazam so'rab, timestamp'li OCSP javobini TLS handshake'ga "qistiradi" — client tezroq va maxfiyroq (CA'ga so'rov yubormaydi).

questions.question: HSTS nima?
questions.explanation: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload header — brauzer domen bilan faqat HTTPS orqali gaplashadi, SSL stripping bloklanadi.

questions.question: Content Security Policy (CSP) nima?
questions.explanation: Brauzer qaysi manbalardan skript, rasm, stil yuklashi mumkinligini cheklovchi HTTP header — XSS va injection'ni kamaytiradi ('unsafe-inline' dan qoching, nonce/hash ishlating).

questions.question: CORS nima?
questions.explanation: Boshqa domendan resurs so'rashga Access-Control-Allow-Origin kabi header'lar bilan ruxsat beruvchi yoki cheklovchi brauzer mexanizmi. CORS — server himoyasi emas, brauzer qoidasi;  va credential'larni birga ishlatib b...

questions.question: SameSite cookie atributi (`Strict`, `Lax`, `None`) nima?
questions.explanation: Cookie cross-site so'rovlar bilan yuboriladimi — boshqaradi; CSRF'dan himoya (Lax — zamonaviy default, None faqat Secure bilan).

questions.question: Container'larda capability'larni olib tashlash nima?
questions.explanation: Container process'idan POSIX capability'larni aniq olib tashlash (--cap-drop=ALL, keyin faqat keraklisi) — escape'da kernel exploit imkoniyati kamayadi.

questions.question: Seccomp BPF filtri (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Container process'i chaqiradigan syscall'larni BPF bilan ushlab ruxsat berish yoki taqiqlash (reboot, mount, unshare kabi xavflilarni bloklash).

questions.question: Docker uchun AppArmor profili nima?
questions.explanation: Container process'lariga fayl yo'llari, tarmoq va raw socket yaratish cheklovlarini majburlovchi kernel LSM profili (docker-default).

questions.question: SELinux Mandatory Access Control nima?
questions.explanation: Process va fayllarga xavfsizlik label'lari (system_u:system_r:container_t) beradi va root huquqidan qat'i nazar qat'iy kernel avtorizatsiya qoidalarini qo'llaydi (container'lar uchun MCS kategoriyalari bilan izolyatsi...

questions.question: Falco qoida sintaksisi qanday?
questions.explanation: Kernel syscall'lari ustida shart belgilovchi deklarativ YAML:

questions.question: BGP route hijacking nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi IP bloklariga egalikni yolg'on e'lon qilib trafikni ushlaydi yoki yo'q qiladi; RPKI (ROV) bilan kamaytiriladi.

questions.question: RPKI nima?
questions.explanation: Autonom tizim ma'lum IP prefikslarini e'lon qilishga ruxsatli ekanini kriptografik tasdiqlovchi framework (ROA) — BGP hijack'larga qarshi.

questions.question: Cloudflare'da Anycast BGP routing qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Ko'p global edge serverlar bir xil IP'ni BGP orqali e'lon qiladi — client trafigi topologik eng yaqin data center'ga boradi, DDoS taqsimlanadi.

questions.question: WireGuard nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel'da ishlaydigan juda tez zamonaviy VPN protokoli: Curve25519, ChaCha20-Poly1305, BLAKE2s; kodi kichik — audit oson.

questions.question: IPsec ESP nima?
questions.explanation: IP paketlar uchun maxfiylik, kelib chiqish autentifikatsiyasi va anti-replay himoyasini beruvchi IPsec protokoli.

questions.question: IPsec IKEv2 nima?
questions.explanation: IPsec security association'larini o'rnatish — shifrlash algoritmlarini kelishish va endpoint'larni autentifikatsiya qilish protokoli.

questions.question: GRE nima?
questions.explanation: Turli L3 protokollarni IP tarmoq ustida virtual point-to-point tunnelga o'raydigan protokol (shifrlamaydi).

questions.question: VXLAN nima?
questions.explanation: L2 Ethernet frame'larni UDP (4789-port) ichiga o'raydigan overlay protokoli — 24-bit VNI bilan 16 milliongacha segment (VLAN'ning 4096 cheklovi o'rniga).

questions.question: CNI tarmog'ida Geneve protokoli nima?
questions.explanation: Moslashuvchan overlay encapsulation (UDP 6081) — kengaytiriladigan metadata opsiyalari bilan; Cilium va OVN ishlatadi.

questions.question: PROXY protocol (v1, v2) nima?
questions.explanation: L4 proxy (NLB, HAProxy) orqali o'tganda TCP ulanish boshiga client'ning haqiqiy IP va portini yozadigan header — backend haqiqiy client IP'ni biladi (backend ham uni qo'llashi shart).

questions.question: SNI (Server Name Indication) nima?
questions.explanation: TLS ClientHello da client ulanmoqchi bo'lgan hostname'ni ko'rsatadi — bitta IP'da bir nechta sertifikat (ochiq matnda ko'rinadi; ECH buni shifrlaydi).

questions.question: TCP keepalive nima?
questions.explanation: Bo'sh TCP ulanishlarda peer tirikligini tekshirish va oraliq firewall/NAT idle yozuvini o'chirib yubormasligi uchun davriy probe paketlari (default 2 soat — ko'pincha qisqartiriladi).

questions.question: TCP window size va flow control nima?
questions.explanation: Qabul qiluvchi ACK'siz buferlashga tayyor bayt miqdori — tez yuboruvchi sekin qabul qiluvchini bosib ketmasligi uchun (window scaling bilan katta oynalar).

questions.question: TCP congestion control (BBR va CUBIC) xavfsizlik/tarmoq kontekstida farqi.
questions.explanation: CUBIC: yo'qotishga asoslangan — paket yo'qolsa throughput'ni kamaytiradi.

questions.question: Ephemeral port exhaustion nima?
questions.explanation: Ko'p qisqa chiquvchi ulanishlar bir xil manzilga client portlarini tugatadi (EADDRNOTAVAIL). Connection pooling/keep-alive, port diapazonini kengaytirish, tcp_tw_reuse bilan oldi olinadi.

questions.question: TCP `TIME_WAIT` holati nima?
questions.explanation: Ulanishni faol yopgan tomon 2×MSL (Linux'da 60s) kutadi — kechikkan paketlar yangi ulanishga aralashmasligi va oxirgi ACK yo'qolsa qayta yuborish uchun. Ko'p TIME_WAIT — odatda keep-alive yo'qligi belgisi.

questions.question: `SO_REUSEPORT` nima?
questions.explanation: Bir mashinada bir nechta process/thread bir xil portga bind qilishi — kernel ulanishlarni ular orasida taqsimlaydi (accept lock contention yo'q).

questions.question: TCP splicing (zero-copy) nima?
questions.explanation: Ikki socket orasida ma'lumotni kernel'da (splice()) userspace'ga nusxalamasdan uzatish — proxy'lar uchun.

questions.question: NIC offloading (TSO, LRO, checksum offload) nima?
questions.explanation: TCP segmentatsiya va checksum hisoblashni NIC hardware'iga topshirish — host CPU tejaladi.

questions.question: SR-IOV nima?
questions.explanation: Bitta fizik PCIe NIC'ni VM/container'larga bir nechta virtual karta (Virtual Function) sifatida bevosita taqdim etish — hypervisor latency'si chetlab o'tiladi.

questions.question: DPDK nima?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq driver'larini userspace'ga ko'chirib poll-mode driver'lar bilan kernel stack'ini chetlab o'tuvchi tez paket ishlov kutubxonalari (CPU yadrolarini to'liq band qiladi).

questions.question: eBPF sockops / sockmap bilan socket'larni tezlashtirish nima?
questions.explanation: Bir node'dagi pod'lar orasida paketlarni yuboruvchi socket'dan qabul qiluvchi socket'ga kernel xotirasida bevosita yo'naltirish — TCP/IP stack'ning katta qismi chetlab o'tiladi.

questions.question: BCC (BPF Compiler Collection) nima?
questions.explanation: Tizim tahlili va tarmoq inspeksiyasi uchun C va Python'da eBPF dasturlari yozish toolkit'i.

questions.question: Calico Felix agenti nima?
questions.explanation: Har node'dagi daemon: NetworkPolicy'larni iptables qoidalari yoki eBPF map'larga tarjima qiladi va route'larni sozlaydi.

questions.question: Vault Agent auto-auth nima?
questions.explanation: Workload'larni Vault'ga Kubernetes ServiceAccount token yoki cloud IAM orqali avtomatik autentifikatsiya qilish va token'ni yangilab turish.

questions.question: Vault response wrapping nima?
questions.explanation: Secret qisqa TTL'li bir martalik token'ga o'raladi. Hujumchi uni ushlab ochsa, haqiqiy qabul qiluvchi ocha olmaydi va buzilish darhol bilinadi.

questions.question: Vault lease ID va revocation nima?
questions.explanation: Har dynamic secret'ning lease ID'si bor; ilova uni muddati tugashidan oldin yangilashi kerak; lease bekor qilinsa bog'liq credential darhol o'chiriladi (prefix bo'yicha ommaviy revoke ham mumkin).

questions.question: Vault performance replication va DR replication farqi.
questions.explanation: Performance: lokal tez o'qish uchun secret'larni secondary klasterlarga (token/lease'lar mahalliy).

questions.question: Sentinel va OPA Rego farqi.
questions.explanation: Sentinel: Terraform Cloud va Vault Enterprise'ga o'rnatilgan HashiCorp'ning xususiy policy engine'i.

questions.question: Kyverno generate qoidasi nima?
questions.explanation: Yangi namespace yaratilganda default NetworkPolicy, ResourceQuota yoki Secret nusxalarini avtomatik generatsiya qilish (synchronize bilan doimiy moslash).

questions.question: Kyverno bilan Pod Security Standards validatsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: CIS va Pod Security Standards'ni sof YAML'da majburlovchi tayyor Kyverno policy to'plamlari (PSA'dan nozikroq istisnolar bilan).

questions.question: Trivy Operator nima?
questions.explanation: Klaster ichida ishlab turgan workload va image'larni doimiy skanerlab natijani Kubernetes CR (VulnerabilityReport, ConfigAuditReport) sifatida chiqaradigan operator.

questions.question: Grype bilan SBOM asosida zaiflik moslash nima?
questions.explanation: Anchore'ning skaneri image layer'larini tortmasdan CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM fayllarini CVE bazalariga solishtiradi — tez va qayta skanerlash arzon.

questions.question: Semgrep nima?
questions.explanation: Syntax tree pattern'lari bilan ko'p tilda xavfsizlik bug'larini topadigan yengil, tez SAST tool'i (custom qoidalar yozish oson).

questions.question: CodeQL nima?
questions.explanation: Kodni so'raladigan ma'lumotlar bazasi sifatida ko'rib, data flow yo'llari va injection zaifliklarini topadigan semantik tahlil engine'i (GitHub Advanced Security).

questions.question: Dependabot security alert nima?
questions.explanation: Dependency'da e'lon qilingan CVE bo'lsa GitHub ogohlantiradi va patch versiya bilan avtomatik PR ochadi.

questions.question: GitHub secret push protection nima?
questions.explanation: git push paytida commit'larni skanerlab, ma'lum formatdagi secret (AWS kalit, Slack token) topilsa push'ni bloklaydi.

questions.question: Canary token (honeytoken) nima?
questions.explanation: Infra'ga ataylab joylashtirilgan soxta credential'lar — kimdir ularni ishlatsa SecOps'ga darhol yuqori prioritetli alert (Thinkst Canary, canarytokens.org).

questions.question: Teleport (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Qisqa muddatli X.509/SSH sertifikatlar va sessiya yozuvi bilan SSH, Kubernetes, DB va web uchun identity-native zero-trust access gateway.

questions.question: Cloudflare Zero Trust (Access / Tunnel) nima?
questions.explanation: Korporativ VPN o'rniga ichki web ilovalarni faqat chiquvchi shifrlangan tunnel orqali, IdP (Okta, Google) autentifikatsiyasi ortida ochish — kiruvchi port ochilmaydi.

questions.question: AWS Verified Access (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: IAM va tashqi identity hamda qurilma holati signallari asosida ichki web ilovalarga VPN'siz xavfsiz kirish.

questions.question: DNS over HTTPS (DoH) va DNS over TLS (DoT) farqi.
questions.explanation: DoH (443-port): DNS so'rovlari oddiy HTTPS ichida — web trafikka aralashadi, bloklash qiyin.

questions.question: Root DNS serverlarida Anycast qanday ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: ta root server IP'si (A–M) Anycast BGP bilan dunyo bo'ylab minglab fizik node'larga taqsimlangan.

questions.question: BGP MED (Multi-Exit Discriminator) nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta kirish link bo'lganda tashqi peer'larga AS'ingizga qaysi yo'l afzalligini taklif qiluvchi ixtiyoriy, tranzitiv bo'lmagan atribut (kichigi afzal).

questions.question: BGP AS-Path prepending nima?
questions.explanation: E'lon qilingan marshrutga o'z AS raqamingizni takrorlab qo'shib yo'lni "uzunroq" qilish — tashqi router'lar uni kamroq afzal ko'radi (primary/backup link uchun).

questions.question: BGP Local Preference nima?
questions.explanation: AS ichida chiquvchi trafik uchun qaysi chiqish yo'li afzalligini belgilovchi atribut (kattasi afzal).

questions.question: IPsec Dead Peer Detection (DPD) nima?
questions.explanation: IPsec endpoint'lari orasida davriy keepalive — masofaviy gateway mavjudligini tekshirib, eskirgan SA'larni tashlaydi.

questions.question: Perfect Forward Secrecy (PFS) nima?
questions.explanation: Har sessiya uchun alohida ephemeral Diffie-Hellman kalitlari — uzoq muddatli private kalit oshkor bo'lsa ham oldingi sessiyalar ochilmaydi.

questions.question: SSL stripping hujumi nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi boshlang'ich HTTP ulanishni ushlab HTTPS'ga o'tishga yo'l qo'ymaydi: server bilan HTTPS, client bilan ochiq HTTP gaplashadi. HSTS (preload) bilan oldi olinadi.

questions.question: CRL (Certificate Revocation List) nima?
questions.explanation: CA chiqaradigan, muddatidan oldin bekor qilingan sertifikat seriya raqamlarining imzolangan, timestamp'li ro'yxati (katta bo'lishi mumkin — OCSP/qisqa muddatli sertifikatlar alternativ).

questions.question: ACME protokoli nima?
questions.explanation: Web server va cert-manager'larga bepul TLS sertifikatlarini avtomatik so'rash, domen egaligini tasdiqlash (HTTP-01, DNS-01, TLS-ALPN-01) va o'rnatish imkonini beruvchi protokol (Let's Encrypt).

questions.question: ACME HTTP-01 va DNS-01 challenge farqi.
questions.explanation: HTTP-01: http://<domain>/.well-known/acme-challenge/ dagi token tekshiriladi (80-port ochiq bo'lishi kerak).

questions.question: ECC va RSA farqi.
questions.explanation: ECC (ECDSA P-256, Ed25519) RSA bilan teng xavfsizlikni ancha kichik kalit bilan beradi (256-bit ECC ≈ 3072-bit RSA) — tezroq handshake va kam CPU.

questions.question: ChaCha20-Poly1305 nima?
questions.explanation: Autentifikatsiyali tez simmetrik stream cipher — AES hardware tezlatkichi bo'lmagan qurilmalar (mobil) uchun optimal.

questions.question: Post-quantum kriptografiya nima?
questions.explanation: Kelajakdagi kvant kompyuterlar (Shor algoritmi) hujumiga chidamli algoritmlar — NIST standartlari ML-KEM (Kyber), ML-DSA (Dilithium); TLS'da gibrid kalit almashinuvi allaqachon qo'llanmoqda ("harvest now, decrypt late...

questions.question: DHE / ECDHE nima?
questions.explanation: Ishonchsiz tarmoqda umumiy simmetrik secret'ni ephemeral kalitlar bilan hosil qilish protokoli — forward secrecy beradi (TLS 1.3 da majburiy).

questions.question: HSM (Hardware Security Module) nima?
questions.explanation: Kalitlarni buzilishga chidamli hardware ichida generatsiya qiladigan, saqlaydigan va ishlatadigan maxsus kriptografik qurilma (FIPS 140-2/3 Level 3) — kalit chiqarib olinmaydi.

questions.question: Kriptografiyada MPC (Multi-Party Computation) nima?
questions.explanation: Bir nechta tomon o'z input'larini oshkor qilmasdan birgalikda funksiya hisoblaydi — masalan raqamli aktiv saqlashda kalitni hech kim to'liq ushlamaydi (threshold signature).

questions.question: Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) nima?
questions.explanation: Prover verifier'ga bayonot rostligini undan boshqa hech qanday ma'lumot oshkor qilmasdan isbotlaydi.

questions.question: Vault KV v2 secrets engine nima?
questions.explanation: Versiyalangan key-value storage: tarixiy versiyalar, soft delete va undelete, check-and-set.

questions.question: Vault cubbyhole secrets engine nima?
questions.explanation: Faqat ma'lum token'ga tegishli, boshqa hech qaysi token kira olmaydigan ichki storage (response wrapping shunga asoslanadi).

questions.question: Vault token TTL va Max TTL farqi.
questions.explanation: TTL: token umri; muddati tugashidan oldin yangilash mumkin.

questions.question: Vault periodic token nima?
questions.explanation: Belgilangan davr ichida yangilab turilsa Max TTL'siz cheksiz yashaydigan servis token'i (uzoq yashovchi servislar uchun).

questions.question: Vault entity va alias nima?
questions.explanation: Entity: Vault ichida bitta inson yoki mashina identity'si.

questions.question: Vault Sentinel integratsiyasi nima?
questions.explanation: Vault secret o'qish/yozishga ruxsat berishdan oldin baholanadigan nozik tashkiliy qoidalar (Role/Endpoint Governing Policies) — Enterprise.

questions.question: Vault Transform secrets engine nima?
questions.explanation: Format-preserving encryption (FPE) va tokenization — karta raqami kabi maydonlarni formatini saqlab shifrlash (Enterprise).

questions.question: Vault KMIP secrets engine nima?
questions.explanation: VMware vSphere va storage massivlari ishlatadigan kalitlarni boshqarish uchun markaziy KMIP server sifatida ishlaydi.

questions.question: Kyverno policy report'lari nima?
questions.explanation: Kyverno yaratadigan CRD'lar (PolicyReport, ClusterPolicyReport) — klasterdagi mavjud resurslarning siyosatlarni buzish holatini ko'rsatadi (background scan).

questions.question: Gatekeeper Constraint nima?
questions.explanation: ConstraintTemplate ning aniq Kubernetes kind va namespace'larga parametrlar va enforcement action (deny, warn, dryrun) bilan qo'llangan nusxasi.

questions.question: Falco gRPC output nima?
questions.explanation: Falco alert'larini gRPC orqali SIEM yoki avtomatik remediation operatorlariga stream qilish.

questions.question: Falcosidekick nima?
questions.explanation: Falco alert'larini 50+ manzilga (Slack, PagerDuty, Lambda, Kafka) yo'naltiradigan hamroh daemon; avtomatik javob (pod'ni o'chirish) ham mumkin.

questions.question: `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` nima beradi?
questions.explanation: Container root fayl tizimi read-only — hujumchi /bin ga backdoor yoki fayl yozolmaydi; yozish kerak bo'lgan joylar uchun alohida emptyDir.

questions.question: `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false` nima?
questions.explanation: Child process parent'dan ko'proq huquq ololmaydi (no_new_privs — setuid binary'lar huquq oshirmaydi).

questions.question: Container tarmog'ida veth pair nima?
questions.explanation: Container'ning private network namespace'ini host bridge yoki CNI router'iga ulaydigan virtual Ethernet "kabel".

questions.question: Container tarmog'ida Linux bridge nima?
questions.explanation: Host'da container veth interfeyslari va fizik NIC orasida frame'larni uzatadigan dasturiy L2 switch (brctl eskirgan — ip link/bridge).

questions.question: `conntrack` (connection tracking) nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha faol ulanishlar holatini (NEW, ESTABLISHED, RELATED) kuzatuvchi kernel quyi tizimi — stateful firewall va NAT (kube-proxy) shunga tayanadi.

questions.question: Conntrack jadvali to'lib qolishi nima?
questions.explanation: Ulanishlar nf_conntrack_max dan oshsa kernel yangi paketlarni tashlaydi (dmesg: "nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet"). nf_conntrack_max ni oshirish, timeout'larni kamaytirish, DNS uchun NodeLocal cache.

questions.question: `net.ipv4.ip_forward=1` nima?
questions.explanation: Host'ga interfeyslar orasida paketlarni yo'naltirishga ruxsat — container routing va CNI uchun zarur.

questions.question: Reverse path filtering (`rp_filter`) nima?
questions.explanation: Kiruvchi paket manbasi shu interfeys orqali qaytish marshrutiga mosligini tekshiradi — IP spoofing'ga qarshi (asimmetrik routing'da muammo berishi mumkin — loose rejim).

questions.question: TCP Fast Open (xavfsizlik/tarmoq kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Yaroqli TFO cookie'ga ega qaytgan client'lar ma'lumotni SYN ichida yuboradi — ulanishda 1 RTT tejaladi.

questions.question: TCP SACK (tarmoq kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Qabul qiluvchi tartibsiz kelgan segmentlarni tasdiqlaydi — yuboruvchi butun oynani emas, faqat yetishmaganlarini qayta yuboradi.

questions.question: `epoll` va `select` (tarmoq kontekstida) farqi.
questions.explanation: select() kuzatilayotgan FD soniga chiziqli (O(N)) va 1024 bilan cheklangan; epoll event-driven, faqat tayyorlarini qaytaradi — yuz minglab ulanish.

questions.question: `SO_LINGER` nima?
questions.explanation: close() yuborilmagan ma'lumot ketguncha bloklanishini yoki linger=0 bilan darhol RST yuborib socket'ni uzishini belgilaydi (RST TIME_WAIT'ni chetlaydi, lekin ma'lumot yo'qoladi).

questions.question: TLS 1.3 key schedule nima?
questions.explanation: HKDF yordamida handshake va application traffic kalitlarini bosqichma-bosqich hosil qiluvchi kalit derivatsiya jarayoni.

questions.question: ESNI / Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) nima?
questions.explanation: TLS ClientHello dagi hostname'ni (va boshqa maydonlarni) shifrlaydi — ISP va kuzatuvchilar qaysi domenga kirilayotganini ko'rmaydi.

questions.question: HTTP/2 HPACK nima?
questions.explanation: Huffman kodlash va umumiy dinamik header jadvallari bilan HTTP header'larini siqish — takroriy header'lar qayta yuborilmaydi.

questions.question: HTTP/3 QPACK nima?
questions.explanation: QUIC uchun header siqish formati — mustaqil stream'lar orasida head-of-line blocking yaratmaydi.

questions.question: DNS rebinding hujumi nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi domeni DNS A yozuvini dinamik ravishda 127.0.0.1 yoki ichki IP'ga o'zgartirib, brauzerni ichki servislarga so'rov yuborishga majburlaydi (same-origin chetlab o'tiladi). Himoya: Host header tekshiruvi, ichki s...

questions.question: CSRF nima?
questions.explanation: Autentifikatsiyalangan foydalanuvchi brauzerini mavjud cookie'lar bilan ishonchli saytga ruxsatsiz so'rov yuborishga aldash. Himoya: CSRF token, SameSite cookie, Origin tekshiruvi.

questions.question: SSRF nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi backend serverni ichki tizimlarga so'rov yuborishga majburlaydi (masalan http://169.254.169.254 dan EC2 credential o'g'irlash). Himoya: allowlist, ichki IP'larni bloklash (redirect va DNS rebinding'ni hisobga...

questions.question: Command injection nima?
questions.explanation: Sanitize qilinmagan input ;, &&, | orqali tizim buyruqlarini bajaruvchi funksiyalarga o'tib ixtiyoriy shell buyruq bajarilishi. Himoya: shell'siz exec (argument array), allowlist validatsiya.

questions.question: Path traversal nima?
questions.explanation: Input'da ../ bilan web root tashqarisidagi fayllarga (/etc/passwd) kirish. Himoya: yo'lni kanonik qilib asosiy papka ichida ekanini tekshirish.

questions.question: Insecure deserialization nima?
questions.explanation: Maxsus tayyorlangan serialize obyektlar (Python pickle, Java serialization) qayta tiklanishda zararli kod bajaradi. Himoya: ishonchsiz ma'lumotni native serialize formatida qabul qilmaslik (JSON + sxema).

questions.question: XXE injection nima?
questions.explanation: Tashqi entity'larni qayta ishlovchi zaif XML parser orqali server fayllarini o'qish yoki ichki port skani. Himoya: parser'da DTD/external entity'larni o'chirish.

questions.question: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) hujumi nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi ikki tizim orasidagi aloqani ularga bildirmasdan ushlab, o'zgartirishi mumkin. Himoya: TLS sertifikat tekshiruvi, mTLS, (ehtiyot bilan) pinning.

questions.question: Downgrade hujumi nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi TLS kelishuvini zaif eski cipher'larga yoki ochiq HTTP'ga tushirishga majburlaydi. Himoya: eski protokollarni o'chirish (faqat TLS 1.2+), TLS 1.3 downgrade himoyasi, HSTS.

questions.question: Buffer overflow (memory corruption) nima?
questions.explanation: Buffer'ga ajratilgandan ko'p ma'lumot yozib qo'shni xotirani ustidan yozish va ixtiyoriy kod bajarish. ASLR, NX, stack canary va memory-safe tillar (Rust, Go) bilan kamaytiriladi.

questions.question: ASLR nima?
questions.explanation: Stack, heap va kutubxonalar manzillarini tasodifiylashtiruvchi xavfsizlik funksiyasi — exploit'lar manzilni oldindan bila olmaydi.

questions.question: NX / DEP nima?
questions.explanation: Ma'lumot sahifalarini bajarib bo'lmaydigan deb belgilovchi hardware funksiyasi — buffer'ga kiritilgan kod ishga tushmaydi (hujumchilar ROP'ga o'tadi).

questions.question: LKM rootkit nima?
questions.explanation: Kernel xotirasiga yuklanib syscall'larni hook qiladigan va process, fayl, ulanishlarni userland tool'lardan yashiradigan zararli modul. Himoya: modul imzosi, lockdown, Secure Boot.

questions.question: eBPF rootkit nima?
questions.explanation: eBPF hook'lariga yuklanib paketlarni o'zgartiradigan yoki process'larni yashiradigan, diskda iz qoldirmaydigan yashirin zararli dastur. Himoya: CAP_BPF/CAP_SYS_ADMIN ni cheklash, unprivileged BPF'ni o'chirish, yuklang...

questions.question: Dependency confusion hujumi nima?
questions.explanation: Hujumchi ichki private paket nomi bilan bir xil nomdagi zararli paketni public registry'ga (npm/PyPI) joylaydi — CI noto'g'ri sozlangan bo'lsa yuqori versiyali public'ni yuklaydi. Himoya: scope/namespace, private regi...

questions.question: Typosquatting hujumi nima?
questions.explanation: Mashhur paket nomiga o'xshash xato yozilgan nom bilan (cross-env va crossenv) cryptominer yoki backdoor joylash. Himoya: lockfile, review, allowlist, SCA.

questions.question: Git'da imzolangan commit'lar (GPG / SSH / S/MIME) nima?
questions.explanation: Commit'larni private kalit bilan imzolash — commit haqiqiy dasturchidan ekanini tasdiqlaydi (author maydonini soxtalashtirish oson). Branch protection'da "require signed commits".

questions.question: Git branch protection qoidasi nima?
questions.explanation: Himoyalangan branch'ga (main) merge'dan oldin majburiy review, o'tgan CI check'lar, imzolangan commit, linear history; force push va o'chirishni taqiqlash.

questions.question: Prod kirishda "two-person rule" nima?
questions.explanation: Har qanday imtiyozli o'zgarish yoki kirish bajarilishidan oldin ikki mustaqil vakolatli shaxs tasdig'ini talab qilish.

questions.question: JIT privileged access (xavfsizlik kontekstida) nima?
questions.explanation: Vaqt bilan cheklangan (masalan 2 soatlik) yuqori prod huquqi — avtomatik tugaydi, so'rov va tasdiq audit qilinadi.

questions.question: DevOps xavfsizligida honeytoken nima?
questions.explanation: Kod yoki repo'ga ataylab joylashtirilgan soxta API token yoki DB akkaunti — ishlatilsa SecOps'ga alert, hujumchi borligini aniqlaydi.

questions.question: Zero Trust device posture checking nima?
questions.explanation: Resursga kirishdan oldin qurilma mosligini tekshirish: disk shifrlangan, OS yangilangan, EDR ishlayapti.

questions.question: Dynamic Data Masking (DDM) nima?
questions.explanation: So'rovchi huquqiga qarab sezgir ustunlarni real vaqtda niqoblash (XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234) — ma'lumot o'zgarmaydi, faqat ko'rinish.

questions.question: Enterprise DevSecOps maturity framework qanday?
questions.explanation: Reaktiv: reliz'dan keyin ad-hoc patch.
